# Free test fixtures

These files are downloaded only to exercise Unity import and audio pipelines.
They are not wired into the game yet because this workspace has no Unity 6000.3.0f1 Editor available.

## Sources and licenses

- `Kenney/BlockyCharacters/character-a.glb` and `Textures/texture-a.png`: Kenney asset mirror, CC0 1.0. Source: https://github.com/shorepine/kenney (pinned source tree: `3d/blocky-characters`).
- `Kenney/InterfaceSounds/click_001.wav` and `bong_001.wav`: Kenney Interface Sounds, CC0 1.0. Source: https://github.com/Calinou/kenney-interface-sounds.

The original license texts are kept beside the files. Unity import, material assignment, rigging, AnimatorController creation, and runtime validation remain pending until the exact Unity Editor is available.
